visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair and highlights, wearing a grey t-shirt and a silver necklace, speaks directly into the camera in a close-up shot. She has an animated facial expression with wide eyes. (2) The scene shifts to a well-lit bedroom with white built-in cabinets and a wooden floor. A young boy in a black t-shirt and black pants with white stripes is playing with a basketball, dribbling it energetically before running towards a bed in the corner. (3) The boy dives onto the bed and pulls a light yellow blanket featuring various colorful dinosaur illustrations over himself, disappearing under it. (4) The woman reappears, now sitting on the same bed, holding the dinosaur-patterned blanket. She displays the blanket's texture to the camera, touching and pulling it. (5) She then picks up a white pillow, demonstrating its softness and elasticity by squeezing it. The background shows the white cabinets and bed frame in bright indoor lighting. (6) In the final segment, the woman continues talking while holding the blanket, eventually pulling it up towards her neck and smiling brightly, showing the full dinosaur print again.
